THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING IN 'B' GROUP, THROUGH PHYSICAL HEARING/VIDEO CONFERENCING THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.I.ARUN  ORAL ORDER 1.

The case of the petitioner is that certain lands belonging to him in Sy.No.31 and Sy.No.4 at Chapparadahalli Village, Kundana Hobli, Devanahalli Taluk, Bengaluru Rural District and Sy.No.112/1 and Sy.No.112/2 at Dodddagollahalli Village, Kundana Hobli, Devanahalli NC:
2024:KHC:31674 Taluk, Bengaluru Rural District was acquired for purposes of the Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board ('KIADB' for short).
However, respondent no.3 has passed a general award and deposited the compensation in the Reference Court.
It is further submitted by the petitioner is that he is desirous of getting developed land instead of monetary compensation for the acquired land.

2. The learned counsel appearing for the respondents submit that they have no objection to pass a consent award provided the petitioner produce all the relevant documents to show that he is the owner of the properties acquired.
It is further submitted that if the policy of the Government permits allotment of developed land in lieu of monetary compensation, even that will be considered.

sentences.text: 3. Under similar circumstances, this Court in umpteen number of cases has permitted the land losers to claim compensation as per the consent award upon establishing the fact that they are the owners of the property.
There is NC: 2024:KHC:31674 no reason why a similar order should not be passed in the instant case also.

4. Hence, the following:
ORDER (i) The impugned general awards dated 06.06.2023 at Annexures-A, B and C to the writ petition insofar as the lands of the petitioner, which is the subject matter of the instant writ petition, is set aside;
